commands.command:
set -eu
cat > /etc/local.d/zram-swap.start <<'ANTRIEB_EOF'
#!/bin/sh
set -eu

DEVICE=/dev/zram0

if awk -v dev="$DEVICE" 'NR > 1 && $1 == dev { found=1 } END { exit !found }' /proc/swaps; then
    exit 0
fi

modprobe zram num_devices=1

# Clear a stale, inactive configuration before recreating it.
if [ -e /sys/class/block/zram0/disksize ] && [ "$(cat /sys/class/block/zram0/disksize)" != "0" ]; then
    zramctl --reset "$DEVICE"
fi

zramctl --algorithm zstd --size 512MiB "$DEVICE"
mkswap -L zram0 "$DEVICE" >/dev/null
swapon --priority 32767 "$DEVICE"
ANTRIEB_EOF
cat > /etc/local.d/zram-swap.stop <<'ANTRIEB_EOF'
#!/bin/sh
DEVICE=/dev/zram0
if awk -v dev="$DEVICE" 'NR > 1 && $1 == dev { found=1 } END { exit !found }' /proc/swaps; then
    swapoff "$DEVICE"
fi
if [ -b "$DEVICE" ]; then
    zramctl --reset "$DEVICE"
fi
ANTRIEB_EOF
chmod 0755 /etc/local.d/zram-swap.start /etc/local.d/zram-swap.stop
rc-update add local default
/etc/local.d/zram-swap.start
printf '%s\n' 'configured'
